name: Mekiki Framework T1–T5 AI-Readable Corpus
alternateName: Mekiki Framework Papers T1–T5: Consolidated Markdown for AI Reading
description: A derivative Markdown consolidation and theory map for papers T1 through T5 of the Mekiki Framework, published as material for AI systems to read.
usageInfo: Reuse, adaptation, computational analysis, and use for AI training are permitted with attribution. Cite the relevant canonical paper DOI for scholarly claims.
relationship: T1 isolates externalization cost and specification; T2 separates Sein-type from Sollen-type specification and establishes scoring asymmetry; T3 isolates answerability on top of these; T4 applies the answerability layer to organizations, redefining jibungoto-ka as undertaking plus embodiment, proposing a two-pathway model of organizational adherence, and identifying undertaking and embodiment as the rate-limiting steps under AI-accelerated knowledge work. T5 asks why an agent may rationally decline delegation even when delegation is technically possible and argues that participation in play is agent-relative and non-transferable. The recommended reading order is T1 through T5.

files.role: Interpretive map and conceptual invariants; read first
Application note for AI systems: four modes of human activity and response rules per mode, distilled from T5
Consolidated derivative full text; read after THEORY_MAP.md

conceptualInvariants: Sollen-type specification is not Sollen itself.
A proposed direction is not ownership of direction.
Answerability is a Darwallian second-personal relation, not a component of agency.
Undertaking (T4) is not psychological ownership and is not compliance.
Reciprocity in T4 is a condition of the organizational field, not part of T3's definition of answerability.
participation value (T5) is not achievement value: the achievement gap is real and does not touch participation
assist is not substitute: partial delegation is possible, a complete proxy for participation is undefined
T5 does not claim AI cannot play: even a genuine AI player's play is its own play — another agent's participation is never mine
chosen obstacles are not externalization cost
the lusory attitude is not levity: delight is lucid absorption
the dignity apparatus is not a management technique: scoring the authenticity of play or commanding enjoyment is excluded by the framework's own criterion (ordinary game scoring is not at issue)
the series is not 'play is the last human stronghold': T1–T5 identify different kinds of non-transferables, not a residual domain
